data.summary_suggestion: Submit A6 medical data records to reporting system
data.description_suggestion: Submits A6 medical data records to the healthcare statistical reporting system. Accepts a payload containing credentials (program: "BAOCAO") and an array of baocao23Data objects with A6 patient information. Returns a pID (unique submission identifier) and jobReference URL for tracking submission status. Validates all input fields according to defined formats (e.g., dates as yyyy-MM-dd, gender as M/F). Returns validation errors for any invalid fields. Optional fields can be omitted from the payload. Requires bearer token authentication from https://auth.ngsp.nhic.vn/oauth2/token. The pID should be retained for data reconciliation purposes.

data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve A6 data submission job status and logs
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the processing status and detailed logs for an A6 data submission job. Requires the pID (submission identifier) returned from the import operation as a query parameter. Returns a chronological array of job events including: (1) initial job start event with timestamp, (2) intermediate processing events showing individual record creation/update results with status codes and messages, and (3) final job completion event. Each event includes completedAt timestamp (ISO 8601 format), category (IMPORT_JOB), log level (INFO), and response details. Use this operation to monitor submission progress and diagnose any processing errors. Requires bearer token authentication.
